⚡ xTerminal — Next-Generation Multi-Protocol DevOps & SSH Terminal Workstation

xTerminal is an ultra-fast, modern, and secure terminal workstation engineered for DevOps engineers, cloud architects, sysadmins, and network professionals. Manage your Windows systems, Linux servers, cloud infrastructure, network switches, and IoT hardware from a single unified workstation.

🚀 CORE FEATURES:
• Full-duplex SSHv2, Telnet, Serial Console (COM / WebSerial), and Android ADB support.
• Built-in local Windows PowerShell & CMD PTY terminal with split panes.
• Persistent background sessions — switching tabs never drops your active connection.
• Full xterm.js emulation with syntax highlighting and customizable themes.
• Multi-Host Command Orchestrator: Execute shell commands across multiple servers in parallel with risk analysis.
• Real-Time Server Telemetry: Live CPU, RAM, and bandwidth meters with SFTP transfer queues.
• Multiplayer Collaboration: Share live terminal sessions securely with team members.
• Universal Importer: One-click migration from PuTTY, Termius, SecureCRT, and MobaXterm.
• Local Encrypted Vault: Passwords and SSH keys are encrypted locally on your PC (AES-256) with zero telemetry tracking.
